Valid implications: F-circuit => E-circuit (same circuit). Over a FIXED finite field F_p: F-circuit of size s => Boolean circuit of size O(s log^2 p) for the F_p-valued function on Boolean inputs (arithmetic mod p simulated gate by gate).
